user.title: Connect to NATS
user.description: Enter the address of your NATS server. Leave username and password empty if the server allows anonymous access.

data_description.url: For example nats://192.168.1.10:4222 (or tls:// for TLS).
data_description.client_name: Shown in the server's connection list.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with NATS
reauth_confirm.description: The server at {url} rejected the saved credentials. Enter the current ones.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the NATS server at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the username or password.
error.invalid_url: Use a URL like nats://host:4222 or tls://host:4222.

abort.single_instance_allowed: NATS is already configured. Only one server is supported.

init.title: Subscriptions and consumers
init.description: Every message received fires a `nats_message` event.

data_description.subscribe: Core subscriptions, at-most-once. Wildcards allowed: `*`, and `>` as the last token.
data_description.consume: At-least-once. A list like `- stream: REPLIES` / `durable: ha` / optional `filter_subject: replies.>`. Missing consumers are created.

error.invalid_subject: One of the subjects isn't valid: no spaces or empty tokens, and `>` only at the end.
error.invalid_consumer: Each consumer needs `stream` and `durable`, and an optional valid `filter_subject`.

deprecated_yaml.title: NATS YAML configuration was imported
deprecated_yaml.description: Your `{domain}:` YAML configuration has been imported into the UI. Remove it from your YAML files and restart Home Assistant; manage the connection and subscriptions under Settings → Devices & services → NATS from now on.

publish.name: Publish
publish.description: Publishes a message to a NATS subject. Returns the subject, and with JetStream also the stream and sequence number.

subject.name: Subject
subject.description: Subject to publish to. No spaces or wildcards.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: A mapping or list is sent as JSON; a string is sent as-is.

headers.name: Headers
headers.description: Optional NATS headers (string keys and values).

jetstream.name: JetStream
jetstream.description: Publish through JetStream and wait for the stream's ack. Requires a stream that captures the subject.

not_loaded.message: The NATS integration isn't set up or is disabled.

not_connected.message: Not connected to the NATS server.

permission_denied.message: The NATS server doesn't allow this user to publish to {subject}. Check the user's publish permissions.
